statements.name: create_table
statements.sql: CREATE TABLE iceberg.bronze.synthetic_events (input_sequence INTEGER,event_id VARCHAR,sensor_id VARCHAR,event_time_raw VARCHAR,sensor_value DOUBLE,source_sha256 VARCHAR) WITH (format='PARQUET',format_version=2,location='s3://platform-lab-iceberg-plan2-20261016/warehouse/phase6/bronze/synthetic_events');

statements.name: read_initial_empty
statements.sql: SELECT input_sequence,event_id,sensor_id,event_time_raw,sensor_value,source_sha256 FROM iceberg.bronze.synthetic_events ORDER BY input_sequence;

statements.name: read_snapshot_1
statements.sql: SELECT input_sequence,event_id,sensor_id,event_time_raw,sensor_value,source_sha256 FROM iceberg.bronze.synthetic_events ORDER BY input_sequence;

statements.name: read_snapshot_2
statements.sql: SELECT input_sequence,event_id,sensor_id,event_time_raw,sensor_value,source_sha256 FROM iceberg.bronze.synthetic_events ORDER BY input_sequence;

inspection.snapshots: SELECT snapshot_id,parent_id,operation,element_at(summary,'added-records') AS added_records,element_at(summary,'total-records') AS total_records FROM iceberg.bronze."synthetic_events$snapshots" ORDER BY committed_at,snapshot_id;
inspection.history: SELECT * FROM iceberg.bronze."synthetic_events$history" ORDER BY made_current_at;
inspection.files: SELECT file_path,file_format,record_count,file_size_in_bytes FROM iceberg.bronze."synthetic_events$files" ORDER BY file_path;
inspection.counts: SELECT count(*) AS input_rows,count(DISTINCT event_id) AS distinct_event_ids,count_if(sensor_id='sensor-a') AS sensor_a,count_if(sensor_id='sensor-b') AS sensor_b,count_if(try(from_iso8601_timestamp(event_time_raw)) IS NULL) AS bad_timestamp,count_if(sensor_value<0 OR sensor_value>100) AS out_of_range FROM iceberg.bronze.synthetic_events;
